connector.name: Gpusmarket
connector.registryDescription: Rent real GPUs from the terminal. Per-second billing, $0.50 minimum. stdio MCP server.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.gpusmarket.com over server sent events, also runs locally from the npm package gpusmarket. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jyswee account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token using your GPUsMarket API key: 'Bearer gpu_...'. Optional: without one the server starts in onboarding mode and can self-signup via the gpusmarket_signup tool.

env.name: GPUSMARKET_API_KEY
env.description: GPUsMarket API key (gpu_...). Required: the MCP server exits without one. Get a key with 'gpusmarket signup' or from your dashboard.
